name: email-service
description: Tell a researcher what happened to their candidate — revision requested or rejected — and check whether it was actually delivered.
notes: The two kinds that belong to this actor are candidate_revision_requested and candidate_rejected. Sending prereview_completed from here would make one mailbox speak for both the Centre Agent and the Owner.

Accepted for delivery is not delivered, and neither is a domain fact changing. record_review already committed the decision before this call; if the mail fails, the decision still stands and only the human was not told.

dedupe_key is the business identity (this decision, on this candidate head). Reusing a dedupe_key with different content returns idempotency_conflict rather than sending a second, contradictory message.

tools.name: send_notification
tools.description: Accept one human_notification_intent for later delivery.
allowed: telling a researcher their candidate needs a new version
telling a researcher their candidate was rejected

tools.name: get_notification_status
tools.description: Read delivery status. Ordinary callers only see their own notifications.
allowed: checking whether the researcher was actually told

tools.name: health
tools.description: Return authenticated component status for delivery, audit, and mailbox.
